INSIDE TRACK: Homegrown riders go to war for the places Bowman left open
Derek Leung Ka-chun called it "a real war" when he spoke to The Standard this week about the fight among Hong Kong's homegrown jockeys for the local place in the LONGINES International Jockeys' Championship and for the Tony Cruz Award given to the leading ‘homegrown’ rider at season’s end. Leung meant it as a genuine compliment. Behind Zac Purton's 26 winners, Nichola Yuen Hang-yiu, Jerry Chau Chun-lok, Vincent Ho Chak-yiu and Leung hold the next four places on the jockeys' table.
